items.question: Can I search live listings here?
items.answer: This demo has sample cards, not a live search. It is not connected to an MLS or IDX feed, so nothing on it is for sale.

items.question: Which cities do the guides cover?
items.answer: The guides cover DeSoto, Cedar Hill, Duncanville, and Lancaster in southwest Dallas County.

items.question: Is the home-value form an appraisal?
items.answer: A home-value request is not an appraisal. It would start a conversation if this were a live site.

items.question: Do the forms send email or save data?
items.answer: The forms do not send, and the phone and email are placeholders.

items.question: What does the practice charge?
items.answer: What the practice is paid is not listed here. Compensation is negotiable and is not set on this demo.
